name: TTS Benchmark Run
short_description: Run a TTS inference benchmark measuring TTFB, speaker similarity, and RTF.
detailed_description: Covers tasks that benchmark a TTS system (ElevenLabs API or local Kokoro model) on the filler corpus or val_96 set. Measures time-to-first-byte, GE2E speaker similarity against ElevenLabs David reference, and real-time factor. Results must include per-clip metrics and aggregate p50/p95/p99 for latency.
